harper: Quick follow-up from the postmortem: I'm consolidating action items for GPU capacity/autoscale. Please claim and drop ETA.

marta: I'll take the temporary quota request and billing loop. ETA Fri 18:00 UTC.

jordan: I'll own scheduler tuning + canary. Plan: +15% max_pending and reduce batch_window_ms for latency routes, canary on gpu-canary-7. ETA Tue COB.

tess: I'll update the runbook with exact mitigation commands and an automated checklist for oncall. PR by Wed AM.

harper: Action register (short): quota (marta), scheduler canary (jordan), runbook (tess), telemetry alert for headroom <10% (ops-bot).

ops-bot: Created INFRA-980 (quota), INFRA-981 (scheduler canary), INFRA-982 (runbook), INFRA-983 (telemetry). Links: https://tracker.internal/INFRA-980..983.

marta: For the quota ticket I need a one-line justification. Use: "Sustained bursts exceeded reserved pool, requesting temporary soft quota to restore headroom while autoscaler/scheduler fixes roll out."

jordan: Canary test plan: 30m replay, measure p95, queue depth, GPU util. Rollback if p95 +12% or failed schedules +20. Will attach load script to INFRA-981.

tess: Runbook PR created: https://git.internal/runbooks/gpu-surge/PR-121  includes runnable rbctl commands and rollback steps.

harper: Recurring 15-min check-ins for 4 weeks added: "GPU surge follow-ups" Wed 09:30 UTC. ops-bot scheduled.

ops-bot: Calendar event created: https://calendar.internal/event/8442.

marta: ETA Fri 18:00 UTC (quota + billing).

jordan: ETA Tue COB (canary + smoke test results).

tess: ETA Wed AM (runbook PR).

harper: Thanks all. Please paste any blockers here; we'll escalate to oncall if ETAs slip >48h. This thread will be the canonical action register until tickets close.
